chains_captured.name: raw
chains_captured.signal_chain: Roland JP-8000 stereo out → Radial J+4 (DI / stereo line driver, transformer-balanced) → Teenage Engineering TX-6 ch 1,2 → Mac mini USB → bench
chains_captured.description: Clean DI chain — the JP-8000 voice through the Radial J+4's transformer for level + warmth, captured at the bench. The real spacepit signal path starts here.
chains_captured.credit_line: Captured at the spacepit — JP-8000 → Radial J+4 → TX-6

patches.name: supersaw-1
patches.notes: THE patch — JP-8000's signature 7-saw supersaw. OSC 1: SUPER SAW, all 6 detune voices ON. Filter cutoff ~70%, resonance 30%, env amount 50%. Amp env: A=0, D=0, S=full, R=2sec. Velocity sensitive. Range a2-a5. Used in: Above & Beyond, Armin van Buuren, Daft Punk, virtually every trance track 1997-2010.

patches.name: mega-saw
patches.notes: Wider, fatter supersaw — push the DETUNE knob hard, MIX 100% saw, two-osc layer if possible. Filter wider open (~85%), high res (~50%). Long release. Range a2-a5. Used in: Above & Beyond 'Sun & Moon', Sasha & Digweed sets.

patches.name: tb-echo
patches.notes: JP-8000's TB-303 emulation — modeled after Roland's own 303. OSC sawtooth, FEEDBACK OSC engaged (the secret weapon), filter env amount HIGH, resonance ~70%, short decay. Range a1-a4. Used in: Eric Prydz 'Opus', Tale of Us tracks.

patches.name: trance-pad
patches.notes: Classic trance pad — two supersaws octave-detuned, slow attack (~1sec), full sustain, slow release (3sec). Filter cutoff modulated by LFO (slow triangle). Range c2-c5. Used in: Above & Beyond, ATB, Tiësto early stuff.

patches.name: acid-bass
patches.notes: Squelchy 303-style acid bass via the FEEDBACK OSC trick — saw oscillator, feedback engaged, filter cutoff 30-40%, resonance 80%+, env amount maxed. Range a1-a4. Used in: Hardfloor, Acid Pauli, Josh Wink 'Higher State of Consciousness'.

patches.name: fat-lead
patches.notes: Daft Punk territory — square + saw mix, slight detune, mod wheel sweeps filter cutoff. Punchy env. Range a2-a5. Used in: Daft Punk 'One More Time' lead, French house bangers.

patches.name: analog-strings
patches.notes: Synth strings — two saws octave-stacked, slow attack (~600ms), high cutoff (90%), low res. Chorus engaged. Range c2-c5. Used in: Underworld, Orbital, Sasha pads.

patches.name: pluck-stab
patches.notes: Short percussive stab — square wave, very short decay (~150ms), no sustain. High res for character. Range a2-a5. Used in: UK garage / 2-step productions, MJ Cole stabs.

patches.name: rave-hoover
patches.notes: Classic Roland Alpha Juno hoover sound recreated on JP — saw + sub osc, pulse width modulation slowly, low cutoff, slight pitch wobble (LFO → pitch, very small amount). Range c2-c5. Used in: Joey Beltram 'Mentasm', 90s rave, jungle/dnb stabs.

patches.name: wide-pad
patches.notes: Atmospheric pad — supersaw with maximum detune, very slow attack (2sec+), filter sweep on mod wheel, drenched in built-in chorus. Range c2-c5. Used in: ambient/electronica beds, Boards of Canada-ish tones.

patches.name: fm-bell
patches.notes: FM-style bell — feedback osc + ring mod for metallic harmonics. Short percussive decay, high cutoff. Range c3-c6. Useful for melodic hooks, FKA twigs-style production.

patches.name: sub-bass
patches.notes: Pure sub — sine/triangle low osc only, filter wide open, no envelope movement on filter. Just clean low end. Range a1-a3. Used in: house/techno sub layers, dub productions.

required_synth_setup: Synth must be in PATCH mode (not PERFORM) on the front panel
Performance Control Channel must be OFF (MIDI menu) — otherwise any incoming PC kicks the synth to PERFORMANCE bank, ignoring PATCH mode
Program Change Tx/Rx Switch must be BANK SEL + PC (already on by default usually)
midi_quirks.default_pc_workflow: Bench sends bare Program Change on channel 1. JP-8000 (in PATCH mode + Performance Control OFF) loads the PATCH bank preset at that PC slot. Bank A = PC 0-63 (A11-A88), Bank B = PC 64-127 (B11-B88).
midi_quirks.verified: 2026-05-27 — Nick confirmed PC=38 (PATCH A57 = Euro SAW) loads correctly with Performance Control Channel OFF.
midi_quirks.mode_switching_via_midi: not supported — SINGLE/DUAL/SPLIT toggle is front-panel-only. Bench should pause + prompt user when target_mode changes between queue items.
